description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for persistence ID streaming, including parameters like batch size, timeouts, backoff durations, and restart limits, along with default values and config keys.

classes.name: PersistenceIdsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for persistence ID streaming settings.

classes.name: ConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining known configuration keys and default values for persistence ID streaming.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the batch size for persistence IDs requested per message.

methods.name: getStreamRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for a stream request reply.

methods.name: getStreamIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for keeping the stream open without downstream activity.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration after stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration after stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream resumptions before giving up.

methods.name: getRecovery
methods.description: Returns the period after which the upstream is considered healthy if no error occurs.
